SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.BUYER, A.GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'ILHE') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER AS PLANT, A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, A.KEY_1 AS DATA_STATUS, A.STATUS AS STATUS, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, A.GR_AMT AS GR_AMT, A.ADD_USER_ID AS RCV_SER, A.KEY_2 AS RCV_USER_DEPT_NAME, A.LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, A.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, A.GR_NO AS KEP_GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ AS KEP_GR_SEQ, A.KEY_3 AS DESTINATION_TYPE, A.KEY_4 AS ORG_ID, A.KEY_5 AS TRX_TYPE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
